title: ArchMaker Manifest (DM-MANIFEST, v0)
description: Canonical, closed, ordered and hashed materialization of a Resolution without blockers. Input of exporters and of the v1 plan. The contentDigest follows the canonicalization profile v1 (ADR-0007): SHA-256 over the canonical payload prefixed by the domain label archmaker:manifest:v1. Contract state: v0.
$comment: Contract v0 (phase R6, AUD-015, supported by the AUD-010 canonicalization vectors). contentDigest replaces manifestDigest; unknown fields rejected.

domainLabel.description: Domain separation label used for the canonical hash (ADR-0007).

targetRef.description: Export target the manifest is materialized for.

resolutionDigest.description: Semantic content digest of the Resolution that fed the manifest; traceability back to the ephemeral resolution.

effectiveSelections.description: Frozen effective selections: manual plus derived, ordered by step ID.

requiredCapabilities.description: Capabilities required by the effective selections.

conflicts.description: Remaining conflicts; empty for a sealed manifest.

contentDigest.description: Canonical semantic digest of this manifest payload (ADR-0007, domain tag archmaker:manifest:v1). Distinct from any binary/artifact digest.
